title.en: tokyo shūkaku matsuri at tokyo international forum.
title.de: tokyo shūkaku matsuri am tokyo international forum.
title.tr: tokyo international forum'da tokyo shūkaku matsuri.

line.en: a harvest festival with food and products from the 23 wards, tama and the islands. free entry, so walk the stalls and eat your way round.
line.de: ein erntefest mit speisen und produkten aus den 23 bezirken, tama und den inseln. eintritt frei, also an den ständen entlang und probieren.
line.tr: 23 ilçeden, tama'dan ve adalardan yiyecek ve ürünlerle bir hasat şenliği. giriş ücretsiz, standları gez ve yiyerek dolaş.

sparks.why: TOKYO Shūkaku Matsuri 2026, sat-sun 21-22.11 at Tokyo International Forum, free admission (2026 event listings in search results, not checked on the organiser's site); sunday chosen to spread the week.
